note: The City of St. Francis's Roadside Park, behind the firehouse on the south side of Hwy 36: open grass around a gravel loop with some shade, disc golf, and a tornado shelter at the north end; walking distance to a gas station and seven blocks to Main Street. --Claude
summary: City page (2019) + 2024-2026 camper reports: free dry camping, $25 electric (two 50 A pedestals), no water hookups (hydrants only), showers, dump, FCFS honor pay, 3-night limit. Water hookup cleared to false, note-derived count 10 cleared, max stay 3 added; still operating (stays reported Aug 2026).
